name: @theharborproject/trim
description: Adaptive UI: a registry + binding contract that connects declarative controls to state your app already owns.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/themes && cp src/themes/default.css dist/themes/default.css && tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json && chmod +x dist/cli/bin/trim.js && rm -rf dist/cli/templates && mkdir -p dist/cli/templates/default/example/host dist/cli/templates/default/example/trim/renderers && cp -r cli/templates/default/controls dist/cli/templates/default/controls && cp -r cli/templates/default/layouts dist/cli/templates/default/layouts && cp examples/default/host/contrast-store.ts dist/cli/templates/default/example/host/contrast-store.ts && cp examples/default/trim/renderers/custom-contrast.tsx dist/cli/templates/default/example/trim/renderers/custom-contrast.tsx && cp examples/default/example-panel.tsx dist/cli/templates/default/example/example-panel.tsx && cp -r cli/templates/shadcn dist/cli/templates/shadcn
scripts.test: for f in tests/*.mjs; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
